Overview.Name: R. Sairam Reddy
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Meal_1: Option 1: 4 egg omelette (pan fried in ghee)
Option 2: Chicken curry (small bowl) + 1/2 cup cooked rice (~75 g)
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (small) + 2 boiled eggs
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) + chicken curry + vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + egg curry (3 eggs) + vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + paneer curry (80 g) + vegetable curry
Meal_3: Option 1: Chicken curry (small portion) + 1/2 cup cooked rice (~75 g)
Option 2: Egg omelette (2 eggs) + cucumber salad
Option 3: Paneer cubes (60–80 g) + vegetable curry (lightest option)

Notes_and_Tips: Since gym is included, keep protein strong in both main meals.
Start every meal with eggs or chicken before rice.
Keep rice moderate to support fat loss and muscle definition.
Avoid late-night snacking which increases belly fat.
For savory cravings, choose eggs or chicken instead of fried snacks.
With consistency, expect improved muscle definition and waist reduction in 8–12 weeks.
